title: Jesus Calls the First Disciples
summary: In Jesus Calls the First Disciples, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. Jesus called ordinary people to follow Him.

read_it.prompt: Read Matthew 4:18-22 and underline the part that best shows following Jesus.

tell_it: Jesus called ordinary people to follow Him. In the story, Jesus called fishermen to follow Him. They left their nets and became His disciples.
understand_it: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. Jesus Calls the First Disciples gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus called ordinary people to follow Him.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus called fishermen to follow Him. They left their nets and became His disciples. Ages 8-11 can name the Bible detail in Jesus Calls the First Disciples and the takeaway: following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
teen_explanation: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way. For teens, the lesson is worth discussing honestly because it connects belief with public choices, private motives, and costly obedience.
key_truths: Following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
Jesus Calls the First Disciples shows following Jesus through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When kids think only experts can serve God, the disciples show that following starts with answering Jesus' call.
life_application: When kids think only experts can serve God, the disciples show that following starts with answering Jesus' call.

discussion_questions: Retell Jesus Calls the First Disciples in three beats: setup, hard moment, and response.
Which detail keeps Jesus Calls the First Disciples from becoming just a generic moral?
Where might Jesus Calls the First Disciples help at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Follow Me Footprints
activity.instructions: Cut paper footprints and write what the disciples left behind and what they followed toward.

prayer_prompt: God, show me where Jesus Calls the First Disciples touches my own life, and help me respond with honesty, courage, and obedience.
